arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الْأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ.
transliteration: Allahumma munzilal-kitaabi, saree'al-hisaabi, ihzimil-ahzaaba, Allahummahzimhum wa zalzilhum.
translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.
